items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: My cousin Tati which would be 89 years old now in March, he used to have a gang, his band you know.

ctx.x: The costumes or the parades, what was better? Were the parades better or did everybody mask?

pretty costumes? No they didn't have no pretty costumes in the Mardi Gras my days. They masked, some would mask and plenty Indians but they dressed like the Indian. They didn't no fancy thing. They had guinea blue dress with the yellow bias you know and red and their little short waist like that you know like the real Indian were. Yes. And they danced and they had the basket on the like real Indian. Now the Indian is not real Indian and they fall down the room and sit down and cross the leg like this and eat out…
Were there many instruments out in the street? Any bands that you remember? No.
